'''Juke''' is a common [[Riggs]] card.

==Description==

[[File:CardJuke.png|frameless|118px|left|top]]
Costs 0 energy. When played: 
:1. Move 3 in a random direction.
<br clear=all>

==Upgrades==

===Juke A===

[[File:CardJukeA.png|frameless|118px|left|top]]
Costs 0 energy. When played: 
:1. Move '''4''' in a random direction. (+1)
<br clear=all>

===Juke B===

[[File:CardJukeB.png|frameless|118px|left|top]]
Costs 0 energy. When played: 
:1. Move '''2''' in a random direction. (-1)
:2. '''Gain 1 [[Evade]].'''

<br clear=all>

==Strategy==
Juke is a very cheap way to get out of the way of enemy attacks. Pair it with [[Evade]] cards and, in conjunction with its low cost, use your [[Evade]] to adapt to whichever direction you go. Its 0 cost means that it pairs well with card draw effects that [[Riggs]] conveniently also has in her deck. 

The A upgrade makes you go even farther in the direction you randomly go, in the hope that your deck has enough [[Evade]] such that, regardless of which direction you go, you'll get to safety anyway.

The B upgrade takes the opposite approach, reducing how far you randomly go but instead giving you one [[Evade]]. You can use the [[Evade]] to go as far as the unupgraded version would have taken you, but this way you have the flexibility to maybe backtrack if 1 space is actually a better move than 2, or save the [[Evade]] for a future turn if you're already safe.
